items.lede: California’s DMV banned Waymo’s self-driving cars from freeways after determining that they pose “an imminent hazard to public safety.”
items.title: Waymo Pauses All Highway Rides After California Safety Ban

items.lede: The DMV said Waymo's freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety. Restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken "effective corrective actions" to address the deficiencies.
items.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order

items.lede: Restrictions were made by California's DMV after a driverless Waymo was caught trying to pass a Highway Patrol vehicle that was slowing traffic.
items.title: Waymo is pausing all freeway rides after California DMV says the robotaxis are 'imminent hazard to public safety'

items.lede: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
items.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways

items.lede: Robotaxis already had to be recalled in May after they entered highway construction zones.
items.title: Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why

items.lede: Robotaxi operator suspends driverless rides on high-speed roads nationwide after construction zone incursions and a run-in with patrol vehicles
items.title: California tells Waymo to take the next exit after freeway mishaps

items.lede: The autonomous driving company suspended driverless taxi rides on US highways days after California banned the vehicles on its own freeways Waymo has stopped offering driverless taxi rides on freeways across the US indefinitely.
